### Headline summary
- Hackers are actively exploiting critical remote code execution flaws in Apache Roller, Java4Shell, and PHP, with the latter patched by the vendor. ([Cyber Security News (FeedBurner)](https://cybersecuritynews.com/php-critical-vulnerabilities/), [The Hacker News](https://thehackernews.com/2026/11/php-warns-of-critical-security-flaws.html), [Cyber Security News (FeedBurner)](https://cybersecuritynews.com/apache-roller-rce-exploitation/), [SOC Prime Blog](https://socprime.com/blog/cve-2026-129448-critical-apache-roller-rce-flaw-exploited-in-the-wild/))
- CISA warns of active exploitation of vulnerabilities in Synology, LiteLLM, Apache Axis, and REDCap, linking the attacks to ransomware and cryptomining. ([The Hacker News](https://thehackernews.com/2026/11/cisa-warns-of-4-exploited-flaws-linked.html), [Cyber Security News (FeedBurner)](https://cybersecuritynews.com/flaws-in-synology-litellm-apache-axis-and-redcap/))
- The European Commission confirmed a cyberattack that disrupted services for over ten days, with investigators suspecting the use of the ARTEX AI hacking tool. ([Infosecurity Magazine](https://www.infosecurity-magazine.com/news/commission-ai-attack-systems/), [Security Affairs](https://securityaffairs.com/203483/hacking/european-commission-cyberattack-artex-ai-tool-suspected-in-prolonged-disruption.html))

### CISA warns of actively exploited flaws
CISA warned that hackers are actively exploiting four flaws in Synology, LiteLLM, Apache Axis, and REDCap, linking the attacks to ransomware, cryptomining, and LLMjacking. ([The Hacker News](https://thehackernews.com/2026/11/cisa-warns-of-4-exploited-flaws-linked.html), [Cyber Security News (FeedBurner)](https://cybersecuritynews.com/flaws-in-synology-litellm-apache-axis-and-redcap/))

### Critical Apache Roller RCE flaw actively exploited
Hackers are actively exploiting a critical remote code execution vulnerability in Apache Roller that allows code execution without authentication. ([Cyber Security News (FeedBurner)](https://cybersecuritynews.com/apache-roller-rce-exploitation/), [SOC Prime Blog](https://socprime.com/blog/cve-2026-129448-critical-apache-roller-rce-flaw-exploited-in-the-wild/), [SecurityWeek](https://www.securityweek.com/critical-apache-roller-axis-vulnerabilities-exploited-in-attacks/))

### Java4Shell RCE flaw exploitation
Hackers are exploiting the Java4Shell remote code execution flaw, with attackers using the ARTEX malware to disguise themselves as Chrome. ([Zscaler Research Blogs](https://www.zscaler.com/blogs/security-research/cve-2026-114938-openjdk-base64-decoder-vulnerable-pre-authentication-rce), [Cyber Security News (FeedBurner)](https://cybersecuritynews.com/java4shell-rce-flaw-exploited/), [SecurityWeek](https://www.securityweek.com/java4shell-exploitation-attempts-begin-as-vendors-rush-out-advisories/))

### PHP releases security updates for RCE flaws
PHP released security updates addressing multiple critical remote code execution vulnerabilities. ([Cyber Security News (FeedBurner)](https://cybersecuritynews.com/php-critical-vulnerabilities/), [The Hacker News](https://thehackernews.com/2026/11/php-warns-of-critical-security-flaws.html), [SecurityWeek](https://www.securityweek.com/php-readies-critical-security-updates-to-patch-another-rce-flaw/), [Security Affairs](https://securityaffairs.com/203472/security/php-warns-of-critical-flaws-ahead-of-november-security-release.html))

### European Commission confirms AI-driven cyberattack
The European Commission confirmed a cyberattack that disrupted services for over ten days, with investigators suspecting the use of the ARTEX AI hacking tool. ([Infosecurity Magazine](https://www.infosecurity-magazine.com/news/commission-ai-attack-systems/), [Security Affairs](https://securityaffairs.com/203483/hacking/european-commission-cyberattack-artex-ai-tool-suspected-in-prolonged-disruption.html), [The Record](https://therecord.media/european-commission-confirms-cyberattack-using-ai))

### F5 patches critical NGINX vulnerabilities
F5 released patches for critical NGINX vulnerabilities, including the NGINX2Root remote code execution flaw and two HTTP/2 vulnerabilities, one of which dates back to 2015. ([Security Affairs](https://securityaffairs.com/203440/hacking/nginx2rootai-discovers-five-critical-nginx-flaws-and-a-path-to-root.html), [SecurityWeek](https://www.securityweek.com/f5-patches-critical-nginx2root-flaws-as-poc-exploits-go-public/), [SOC Prime Blog](https://socprime.com/blog/cve-2026-123633-critical-nginx-http-2-use-after-free-flaw-enables-rce/), [HackRead](https://hackread.com/f5-patches-nginx-http-2-vulnerabilities-dating-2015/))

### Drupal patches critical RCE flaw
Drupal patched a critical remote code execution flaw in its installer that could allow unauthenticated attackers to take control of sites, with warnings that exploits may surface quickly. ([BleepingComputer](https://www.bleepingcomputer.com/news/security/drupal-patches-critical-rce-flaw-warns-exploits-may-surface-quickly/), [The Hacker News](https://thehackernews.com/2026/11/drupal-patches-critical-installer-flaw.html))

### Critical VMware vCenter authentication bypass flaws
Broadcom released fixes for five VMware vCenter flaws, including a critical vulnerability that allows network attackers to bypass authentication and access servers. ([The Hacker News](https://thehackernews.com/2026/11/critical-vmware-vcenter-flaw-cvss-98.html), [Cyber Security News (FeedBurner)](https://cybersecuritynews.com/vmware-vcenter-authentication-bypass/))
